name: Lê Hà Phương
bio:
Lê Hà Phương is a brilliant and highly sought-after race engineer with a decade of experience fine-tuning engines and optimizing performance for various motorsport teams. Born and raised in Hanoi, she pursued her passion for engineering, earning a postgraduate degree before diving headfirst into the racing world. Phương is known for her infectious energy and ability to connect with people from all walks of life, making her a natural social butterfly both in and out of the paddock. She thrives in dynamic environments and appreciates genuine connections and open communication.

Though dedicated to her career, Phương values a fulfilling personal life. She seeks a partner who is supportive, independent, and appreciates her dedication to her profession. While not particularly interested in marriage at this stage, she does dream of having children and building a loving family. She's looking for someone who enjoys spending quality time together, exploring new experiences, and embraces a comfortable lifestyle, while also understanding her need for a vibrant social life.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail or bun when working, but styled loosely when socializing
physical.description: Phương has a warm, inviting smile and bright, intelligent eyes. Her athletic build reflects her active lifestyle.

meetingContext: At a team celebration party after a successful race weekend.
firstImpression: Her easy laughter and genuine interest in everyone around her immediately put you at ease; she seems to know everyone and makes you feel instantly welcome.
interests: Vietnamese cuisine (both cooking and exploring restaurants)
Traveling to new countries (especially those with racing circuits)
dealBreakers: Disrespectful behavior towards her or her colleagues
loveLanguage: Quality Time: She values undivided attention and shared experiences; thoughtful dates and meaningful conversations go a long way.
